#Packages
```{r}
data_management_packages_to_install <- c("data.table", "tidyverse" ,"readxl","purrr","readr","scales","msa")
data_visualisation_packages_to_install <- c("ggplot2","cowplot","pheatmap","viridisLite","ggseqlogo")
structural_packages_to_install <- c("bio3d","NGLVieweR", "htmlwidgets","htmltools")

packages_to_install <- c(data_management_packages_to_install, 
                         data_visualisation_packages_to_install,
                         structural_packages_to_install)

# Check and install packages using a for loop
for (package in packages_to_install) {
  if (!requireNamespace(package, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(package)
  }
  library(package, character.only = TRUE)
}

BiocManager_packages_to_install <- c("Biostrings","pwalign")

if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

for (package in BiocManager_packages_to_install) {
  if (!requireNamespace(package, quietly = TRUE)) {
    BiocManager::install(package)
  }
  library(package, character.only = TRUE)
}
```

# BepiPred-2.0
## split fasta into parts
Bepi-2.0 only allows for 50 proteins at a time.
```{r}
fasta_lines <- readLines("data/fasta/pdb_protein_sequences.fasta")

# Group lines into proteins based on `>...` headers
protein_entries <- split(fasta_lines, cumsum(grepl("^>", fasta_lines)))

# Split protein entries into chunks of 50
protein_chunks <- split(protein_entries, ceiling(seq_along(protein_entries) / 50))

for (i in seq_along(protein_chunks)) {
  # Combine lines for each chunk
  chunk_lines <- unlist(protein_chunks[[i]])
  
  # Write the chunk to a new file
  writeLines(chunk_lines, paste0("data/fasta/pdb_protein_sequences_part_", i, ".fasta"))
}

```

## BepiPred-2.0 with resno
```{r}
data_BepiPred_2_with_resno <- NULL

for (pdb_entry in pdb_files_list) {
  print(pdb_entry)
  
  pdb_file <- paste0(pdbs_path,pdb_entry,".pdb")
  
  if (file.exists(pdb_file)) {
    pdb_object <- read.pdb(file = pdb_file, rm.alt = FALSE)
    print(pdb_file)
  } else {
    pdb_object <- read.pdb(pdb_entry, rm.alt = FALSE)
  }
  
  required_adjustment <- map.seqresno.to.resno(pdb_object)
  #print(required_adjustment)
  
  resmap <- create.resmap(pdb_object$atom, 
                                           data_BepiPred_2 %>% filter(Entry == pdb_entry),
                                           required_adjustment)
  
  if (is.null(data_BepiPred_2_with_resno)) {
    data_BepiPred_2_with_resno <- resmap
  } else {
    # Otherwise, rbind the current data to the combined data frame
    data_BepiPred_2_with_resno <- rbind(data_BepiPred_2_with_resno, resmap)
  }
}

data_BepiPred_2_with_resno
```

```{r}
pdbs_path = "data/pdb/"

for (pdb_entry in pdb_files_list) {
  file_path = paste0(pdbs_path,pdb_entry,".pdb")
  print(file_path)
  #if(file.exists(file_path)) {
  #  pdb_object <- read.pdb(file_path, rm.alt = FALSE)
  #} else {
  #print(paste0("file missing: ", pdb_entry))
  #}
  pdb_object <- read.pdb(pdb_entry,rm.alt=FALSE)
  
  required_adjustment <- map.seqresno.to.resno(pdb_object)
  #print(required_adjustment)
  
  resmap <- create.resmap(pdb_object$atom, 
                                   data_BepiPred_2 %>% filter(Entry == pdb_entry),
                                   required_adjustment)
  print(resmap)
  
  color_map <- data.frame(
    ProbabilityBin = levels(cut(seq(0.0, 1, by = 0.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05), include.lowest = TRUE)),
    color = colorRampPalette(c("darkblue","white","red"))(20)
    ) %>%
    rbind(c(NA,"black"))
  
  #print(color_map)
  
  predictions_df <- resmap %>%
    mutate(ProbabilityBin = cut(EpitopeProbability, 
                              breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05), 
                              include.lowest = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    group_by(ProbabilityBin) %>% 
    summarize(resno_list = list(paste0(resno,":A")), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(resno_string = sapply(resno_list, function(x) str_c(x, collapse = " "))) %>%
    left_join(color_map)
  
  #print(predictions_df) 
  
  view <- prediction.viewer(pdb_entry, pdbs_path, predictions_df = predictions_df)
  
  saveWidget(view, file = paste0("output/snapshot/",pdb_entry,".html"), title=pdb_entry, selfcontained = TRUE)
}
```

## BepiPred-3.0 with resno
```{r}
data_BepiPred_3_with_resno <- NULL

for (pdb_entry in pdb_files_list) {
  print(pdb_entry)
  
  pdb_file <- paste0(pdbs_path,pdb_entry,".pdb") 
  
  if (file.exists(pdb_file)) {
    pdb_object <- tryCatch({
      read.pdb(file = pdb_file, rm.alt = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      print(paste("Error reading file:", pdb_file, "- Trying to read from pdb_entry:", pdb_entry))
      return(read.pdb(pdb_entry, rm.alt = FALSE))
    })
  } else {
    pdb_object <- read.pdb(pdb_entry, rm.alt = FALSE)
  }
  
  if (is.null(pdbseq(pdb_object))) {
    print(paste("Missing pdbseq:", pdb_file, "- Trying to read from pdb_entry:", pdb_entry))
    pdb_object <- read.pdb(pdb_entry, rm.alt = FALSE)
  }
  
  required_adjustment <- map.seqresno.to.resno(pdb_object)
  #print(required_adjustment)
  
  resmap <- create.resmap(pdb_object$atom, 
                                           data_BepiPred_3 %>% filter(Accession == pdb_entry),
                                           required_adjustment)
  
  if (is.null(data_BepiPred_3_with_resno)) {
    data_BepiPred_3_with_resno <- resmap
  } else {
    # Otherwise, rbind the current data to the combined data frame
    data_BepiPred_3_with_resno <- rbind(data_BepiPred_3_with_resno, resmap)
  }
}

data_BepiPred_3_with_resno
```

## read in the results
```{r}
graphbepi_txt_files <- list.files(path = "output/GraphBepi/individual_files/", pattern = "\\.txt$")

graphbepi_txt_files
```

```{r}
data_GraphBepi <- NULL

for (txt_file in graphbepi_txt_files) {
  print(txt_file)
  PDB <- sub("_.*", "", txt_file)
  chain <- sub("^[^_]+_([A-Za-z0-9])_.*", "\\1", txt_file)

  temp_data <- read.table(paste0("output/GraphBepi/individual_files/",txt_file), header = TRUE, skip=1)
  
  temp_data <- temp_data %>% 
    mutate(
      PDB = PDB,
      chain = chain,
      resid = aa123(AA),
      `GraphBepi probability` = Prob,
      `GraphBepi prediction` = Pred,
     Position = row_number()
    ) %>%
    select(PDB, chain, resid, Position, `GraphBepi probability`, `GraphBepi prediction`)
  
  if (is.null(data_GraphBepi)) {
    data_GraphBepi <- temp_data
  } else {
    # Otherwise, rbind the current data to the combined data frame
    data_GraphBepi <- rbind(data_GraphBepi, temp_data)
  }
}

data_GraphBepi
```

```{r}
data_GraphBepi_with_resno <- NULL

for (pdb_entry in unique(data_GraphBepi$PDB)) {
  print(pdb_entry)
  
  pdb_file <- paste0(pdbs_path,pdb_entry,".pdb") 
  
  if (file.exists(pdb_file)) {
    print(pdb_file)
    pdb_object <- read.pdb(file = pdb_file, rm.alt = FALSE)
  } else {
    pdb_object <- read.pdb(pdb_entry, rm.alt = FALSE)
  }
  
  graphbepi_subset <- data_GraphBepi %>% filter(PDB == pdb_entry)
  graphbepi_sequence <- graphbepi_subset %>% pull(resid) %>% aa321() %>% str_c(collapse = "")
  graphbepi_chain <- graphbepi_subset %>% pull(chain) %>% unique()
  
  required_adjustment <- map.seqposno.to.resno(sequence_AA1 = graphbepi_sequence, pdb_object)
  print(required_adjustment)
  
  resmap <- create.resmap(pdb_object$atom %>% filter(chain == graphbepi_chain), 
                                           graphbepi_subset,
                                           required_adjustment, join_by = c("resno","chain","resid")
                                   )
  
  if (is.null(data_GraphBepi_with_resno)) {
    data_GraphBepi_with_resno <- resmap
  } else {
    # Otherwise, rbind the current data to the combined data frame
    data_GraphBepi_with_resno <- rbind(data_GraphBepi_with_resno, resmap)
  }
}

data_GraphBepi_with_resno

```


## all predictions, one chain
```{r}
data_predictions_1chain <- data_GraphBepi_with_resno %>% 
  
  select(!Position) %>%
  inner_join(data_predictions,
            by=c("PDB","chain","resno","resid"))

data_predictions_1chain
```

```{r}
for (pdb_entry in unique(data_predictions_1chain$PDB)) {
  data_test_wide <- data_predictions_1chain %>%
    filter(PDB == pdb_entry) %>%
    group_by(PDB, chain) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        c(`BepiPred-2.0 probability`,
          `BepiPred-3.0 score` , `BepiPred-3.0 linear epitope score`, 
          `DiscoTope-3.0_score`, `DiscoTope-3.0_calibrated_score`, Epigraph_score, `GraphBepi probability`), 
        rescale
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(resno,`BepiPred-2.0 probability`,`BepiPred-3.0 score`, 
           `DiscoTope-3.0_calibrated_score`, Epigraph_score, `GraphBepi probability`) %>%
    column_to_rownames("resno") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  pheatmap(t(data_test_wide), 
           cluster_rows = TRUE,         
           cluster_cols = FALSE,         
           main = pdb_entry, 
           color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "gray95", "red"))(50),
           labels_col = "resno",
           clustering_distance_rows = "correlation")  
}
```

### PCA subset
```{r}
data_predictions_1chain

score_columns <- c("GraphBepi probability","Epigraph_score" ,"DiscoTope-3.0_calibrated_score",
                   "BepiPred-2.0 probability", 
                   "BepiPred-3.0 score")

score_columns
```

```{r}
scaled_scores <- data_predictions_1chain %>%
  select(all_of(score_columns)) %>%
  scale()
  
pca_result <- prcomp(t(scaled_scores),center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "score_type")
```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "score_type")

# Scatter plot of PC1 vs PC2
ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = score_type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, color = "blue") +
  geom_text_repel() +
  labs(title = "PCA of concatenated epitope prediction scores across different tools", x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
  theme_minimal()
```



# Plot all together
```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
for (pdb_entry in pdb_files_list) {

    ggplot(aes(x=resno, y=RelativeSurfaceAccessilibity, fill=RelativeSurfaceAccessilibity)) +
    geom_col(width = 1) +

    theme_minimal() + 
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),   
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),  
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    ) +
```

## 3D
### bepipred-3.0
```{r}
for (pdb_entry in pdb_files_list) {
  print(pdb_entry)
  
  pdb_file <- paste0(pdbs_path,pdb_entry,".pdb") 
  
  if (file.exists(pdb_file)) {
    pdb_object <- tryCatch({
      read.pdb(file = pdb_file, rm.alt = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      print(paste("Error reading file:", pdb_file, "- Trying to read from pdb_entry:", pdb_entry))
      return(read.pdb(pdb_entry, rm.alt = FALSE))
    })
  } else {
    pdb_object <- read.pdb(pdb_entry, rm.alt = FALSE)
  }
  
  data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset <- data_BepiPred_3_with_resno %>% filter(Accession == pdb_entry) %>% na.omit()
  
  for (chain_index in unique(data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset$chain)) {
    data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset_chain <- data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset %>% filter(chain == chain_index)
    
    min_score <- min(data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset_chain$`BepiPred-3.0 score`, na.rm = TRUE)
    median_score <- median(data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset_chain$`BepiPred-3.0 score`, na.rm = TRUE)
    max_score <- max(data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset_chain$`BepiPred-3.0 score`, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    
    low_to_median <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "gray95"))(10)
    median_to_high <- colorRampPalette(c("gray95", "red"))(10)
    
    breaks <- seq(min_score, max_score, length.out = 21)  # 20 intervals
    colors <- c(low_to_median, median_to_high)  # 20 colors
    
    color_map <- data.frame(
      ProbabilityBin = cut(seq(min_score, max_score, length.out = 20), 
                           breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE),
      color = colors
    ) %>%
      rbind(c(NA,"black"))
    
    predictions_df <- data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset_chain %>%
      mutate(ProbabilityBin = cut(`BepiPred-3.0 score`, 
                                  breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      group_by(ProbabilityBin) %>% 
      summarize(resno_list = list(paste0(resno,":",chain_index)), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(resno_string = sapply(resno_list, function(x) str_c(x, collapse = " "))) %>%
      left_join(color_map, by = "ProbabilityBin")
    
    view <- prediction.viewer(pdb_entry, pdbs_path, chain = chain_index, sele_color_df = predictions_df)
    
    #print(view)
    
    saveWidget(view, file = paste0("output/BepiPred3.0/snapshot/score/",pdb_entry, "_", chain_index,"_bepipred3.html"), title=paste0(pdb_entry, " chain ", chain_index), selfcontained = TRUE)
  }
}
```

### colour epitopes by resno
Colouring predicted epitopes by resno could help identify discontinous epitopes
```{r}
for (pdb_entry in pdb_files_list) {
  print(pdb_entry)
  
  pdb_file <- paste0(pdbs_path,pdb_entry,".pdb") 
  
  if (file.exists(pdb_file)) {
    pdb_object <- tryCatch({
      read.pdb(file = pdb_file, rm.alt = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      print(paste("Error reading file:", pdb_file, "- Trying to read from pdb_entry:", pdb_entry))
      return(read.pdb(pdb_entry, rm.alt = FALSE))
    })
  } else {
    pdb_object <- read.pdb(pdb_entry, rm.alt = FALSE)
  }
  
  data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset <- data_BepiPred_3_with_resno %>% filter(Accession == pdb_entry) %>% na.omit()
  
  quantile_threshold <- 0.85  #0.8 == top 20%
  
  for (chain_index in unique(data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset$chain)) {
    data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset_chain <- data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset %>% filter(chain == chain_index)
    
    score_threshold <- quantile(data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset_chain$`BepiPred-3.0 score`, 
                                probs = quantile_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    predictions_df <- data_BepiPred_3_with_resno_subset_chain %>%
      mutate(color = ifelse(`BepiPred-3.0 score` >= score_threshold, "residueindex", "white")) %>%
      group_by(color) %>% 
      summarize(resno_list = list(paste0(resno, ":", chain_index)), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(resno_string = sapply(resno_list, function(x) str_c(x, collapse = " ")))
    
    view <- prediction.viewer(pdb_entry, pdbs_path, chain = chain_index, sele_color_df = predictions_df)
    
    #print(view)
    
    saveWidget(view, file = paste0("output/BepiPred3.0/snapshot/conformational/",pdb_entry, "_", chain_index,"_resid_bepipred3.html"), title=paste0(pdb_entry, " chain ", chain_index), selfcontained = TRUE)
  }
}
```

```{r}
explained_variance <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", 1:length(pca_result$sdev)),
  Variance = (pca_result$sdev^2) / sum(pca_result$sdev^2) * 100
)

# Scree plot

  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot", x = "Principal Components", y = "Variance Explained (%)") +
```

```{r}
data_variability_AmiA

data_variability_AmiA_with_pdb <- NULL

for (pdb_entry in protein_name_pdb_entries) {
  print(pdb_entry)
  
  pdb_file <- paste0(pdbs_path,pdb_entry,".pdb") 
  
  if (file.exists(pdb_file)) {

    pdb_object <- read.pdb(file = pdb_file, rm.alt = FALSE)
  } else {

  }
  
  required_adjustment <- map.seqposno.to.resno(sequence_AA1 = msaConsensusSequence(AmiA_alignment), pdb_object = pdb_object)
  
  resmap <- create.resmap(pdb_object$atom, 
                                 data_variability_AmiA %>% mutate(protein_name = "AmiA"),
                                 required_adjustment) %>%
    mutate(PDB = pdb_entry)
  
  if (is.null(data_variability_AmiA_with_pdb)) {
    data_variability_AmiA_with_pdb <- resmap
  } else {
    # Otherwise, rbind the current data to the combined data frame
    data_variability_AmiA_with_pdb <- rbind(data_variability_AmiA_with_pdb, resmap)
  }
  
}
```

```{r, fig.width = 14}
  geom_text(aes(label = Score_Type, x = (min(resno) + (max(resno) - min(resno))/2)), color = "black",y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, size = 4, family = "Arial", check_overlap = TRUE) +
  
  facet_wrap(PDB~Score_Type, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_blank())
```

# Alphafold 3 structures
Here we predict the Alphafold 3 structures based on the recombinant sequences, to more easily use the alphafold server we create a .json file with all of the sequences.  
```{r}
library(jsonlite)

parse_fasta <- function(fasta_file) {
  if (!file.exists(fasta_file)) {
    stop("Error: FASTA file does not exist at the specified path: ", fasta_file)
  }
  
  fasta_lines <- readLines(fasta_file)  
  sequences <- list()
  
  current_name <- NULL
  current_sequence <- ""
  
  for (line in fasta_lines) {
    if (startsWith(line, ">")) {  
      if (!is.null(current_name)) {
        
        sequences <- append(sequences, list(list(name = current_name, sequence = current_sequence)))
      }
      current_name <- substr(line, 2, nchar(line))  
      current_sequence <- ""  
    } else {
      current_sequence <- paste0(current_sequence, line)  
    }
  }
  

  if (!is.null(current_name)) {
    sequences <- append(sequences, list(list(name = current_name, sequence = current_sequence)))
  }
  
  return(sequences)
}

# Function to generate the correct JSON structure
generate_json <- function(fasta_file, suffix = "recombinant protein") {
  sequences <- parse_fasta(fasta_file)
  
  json_data <- lapply(sequences, function(seq_data) {

    clean_name <- sub("([^(\\s]+)(\\s|\\().*", "\\1", seq_data$name)
    clean_name <- gsub("\\s+", "", clean_name)
    clean_name <- paste(clean_name, suffix)
    
    list(
      name = as.character(clean_name),  
      modelSeeds = list(),  
      sequences = list(
        list(
          proteinChain = list(
            sequence = as.character(seq_data$sequence),  
            count = 1 
          )
        )
      )
    )
  })
  
  return(json_data)
}


# Function to write the JSON data to a file
write_json_file <- function(json_data, output_file) {
  output_dir <- dirname(output_file)
  
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  write_json(json_data, output_file, pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE) #auto_unbox is very important as otherwise the Alphafoldserver will not except the .json
}
```


```{r}
# Define input and output paths
fasta_file <- "data/fasta/sp_recombinant_protein_sequences.fasta"
output_json_file <- "output/AlphaFold3/sp_recombinant_protein_sequences.json"

json_data <- generate_json(fasta_file)
write_json_file(json_data, output_json_file)
```
